inputs.base_seed: accepted BASE_SEED_V1 output; current capability degraded by open Prior-RPS audit
inputs.core: accepted same-session Core primitives with source identity and quality
inputs.membership: accepted PIT membership snapshot and common-member snapshots only

membership_gate.failure: membership/identity/coverage uncertainty remains UNKNOWN or DEGRADED; never zero-imputed

primitives.concentration: member amount share; zero denominator UNKNOWN
primitives.deltaK: recompute endpoints on M_t intersect M_(t-K) with both endpoints evaluable; preserve common_count and coverage
primitives.participation_proxy: median member amount_ratio20; distinct from Amount A; not eligibility
primitives.rank_velocityK: sector_rsN_pct[t] - sector_rsN_pct[t-K]; persist both universe snapshots
primitives.sector_rsN_pct: same-day midrank across all type/source/member/coverage-qualified sectors, not preselected sectors
primitives.seed_width: Wilson lower-bound ordering heuristic from BASE_SEED_V1; retain k,n,unknown_count,raw,adjusted; n=0 UNKNOWN; no probability claim
primitives.strong_member_retention: intersection(strong_prev,strong_now) / |strong_prev|; zero denominator NOT_APPLICABLE; incomplete denominator UNKNOWN

quality.unknown: three-valued logic; missing/invalid input UNKNOWN, not FALSE or zero
quality.unknown_sector_type: retain raw diagnostic; exclude formal qualification

stage_record.acceptance_result: CONTRACT_CANDIDATE_ONLY; membership acceptance and formal production are not granted
